angle: Builds expected value from a repeated $1 StatLand bet so the 100-trial arithmetic cancels into sigma notation instead of presenting the formula first.
angle_detail: Start at [03:40], where the payoff table turns probabilities into 100-bet wins and losses, then follow through [08:03] where the trial counts cancel into E notation. Watch that X here means the whole bet payoff, not a single draw outcome as in some course texts. Skip the closing variance teaser around [12:44] since the record marks it uncovered; the second asymmetric bet from [10:30] is worth a second pass once the first clicks.
